proposed.explanation: The available evidence only provides nine-month basic EPS figures for 9M2026 (8.74 EGP) and 9M2025 (4.28 EGP), without full-year 2026 data or fourth-quarter projections needed to accurately calculate the full-year earnings per share and trailing/forward P/E ratio. Furthermore, the total revenue and net profit figures for 9M2026 and 9M2025 are marked AMBIGUOUS due to conflicting unit indicators in the source report, so they cannot be used in calculations. Consequently, there is insufficient evidence to determine full-year EPS, P/E ratio, or whether the share price of 76.21 EGP represents an attractive valuation for purchase.

claims.statement: The reported basic earnings per share for the nine-month period ending September 30, 2026, is 8.74 EGP.
The reported basic earnings per share for the nine-month period ending September 30, 2025, was 4.28 EGP.

limitations: Full-year 2026 financial results and Q4 performance details are not available.
Total revenue and net profit figures are marked ambiguous due to conflicting units in the source report and cannot be used to verify margin profiles or total earnings.
Export sales proportion and currency exposure details are missing from the provided evidence, making it impossible to evaluate exporter-specific risks.
